annotation.title_en: Annual Plan for Promoting the Employment of People with Disabilities – Israel Innovation Authority
annotation.summary_en: Israel Innovation Authority's annual plan for employing people with disabilities. It summarises 2024 activity (affirmative action hires, accessibility training, adjustments) and sets a 2025 plan with designated positions and outreach. Despite the collector title about the robotics sector, it has no robotics or AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target of 5% employees with significant disabilities (8 of 165 staff); representation level rated medium.
Affirmative action applied in hiring and promotion; 2 non-designated positions filled in 2024.
One designated position (student role) planned for 2025.
Outreach to bodies such as Hebrew University accessibility unit and Equal Employment centres.
Accessibility training and a self-learning module planned.
